message.content:
This is the Rittal TS 8 enclosure. CBP rulings on Rittal TS 8 empty enclosures have classified them under 8538.10, which covers boards, panels, consoles, desks, cabinets and other bases for goods of heading 8537 or 8535/8536, not equipped with their apparatus. The subheading is 8538.10.00 and the statistical suffix is 8538.10.0000 (the ruling number is not recalled here). The current HTS has 8538.10.00 with the statistical suffixes 10, 20, 40 and 80. The 2022 version reads 8538.10.00: "Boards, panels, consoles, desks, cabinets and other bases for the goods of heading 8537, not equipped with their apparatus," with statistical suffixes 8538.10.0010 (Parts of ... ) or similar, but the exact suffixes are uncertain. I am going with 8538.10.0000 as the 10-digit code.

{"hts_code": "8538.10.0000", "reason": "An empty powder-coated modular enclosure cabinet (Rittal TS 8 type) designed to house switching and electrical control apparatus, sold without that apparatus, is a cabinet or base for heading 8537 goods and falls in 8538.10."}
